scope: Isolated recovered-client timer expiry, Youngblood retry offer, and retry bomb detonation for Calling for Reinforcements
client: Recovered 1.16.5.0 client; compatibility build, not proven final shutdown revision

observations.finding: After diagnostic advancement of objective-1 timer, the client displayed 00:00:09. The saved database then recorded mission 1995 state 2 (failed) and objective 1 status 3 (failed). Dropship facts were cleared. The harness terminated before a post-expiry screenshot.

Youngblood offered the original-client retry briefing about another bomb and ten minutes. Acceptance created mission 2005 active, objective 1 active with a 600000 ms timer, while 1995 remained failed.

observations.source: playthrough-45/04-retry-bomb.png; playthrough-45/game.log: RequestUseObject at 22:03:50; playthrough-45/06-retry-after.png; playthrough-45/char-after.db
observations.finding: With corrected inferred bomb position (-221.95,102.3,-70.5), the client showed the use prompt. Right click sent RequestUseObject, removed the wreck and advanced mission 2005 objective 1 to complete and objective 4 (Van Valkenberg) to active. The dropship_destroyed fact became 1.

diagnostic_inputs: Run 43 copied an objective-1-active character database; moved the character near Youngblood and set timer_anchor_ms to current time minus 520000 ms to reach expiry quickly.
Run 44 copied the failed run-43 character database and used Youngblood conversation; no live database was changed.

Run 45 copied the retry-active run-44 character database, reset the timer anchor to current time and teleported the character near the wreck. The isolated world copy moved bomb placement 198677 X/Z to (-221.95,-70.5); the isolated world was restored to the seed after the run.
limitations: Timer expiry and retry were observed in a copied database after a diagnostic timer edit and teleports; normal walking progression and full retail presentation remain unverified.
The 600-second timer and corrected bomb coordinate are labelled analogue/inferred reconstructions, not proven final-live values.
No original final-live server capture of failure state was found; this confirms emulator behavior in the compatible recovered client.
